classes.emptyTitle: You don't have any classes yet

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.intro: Hi, {{name}}. The administrator set a temporary password for you. To continue, choose a password only you know.
changePassword.help: At least 8 characters, not the temporary password.

changePassword.offline: The password wasn't changed. We couldn't reach the server. Try again.

users.title: Users
users.noMatch: No user matches “{{query}}”. Check the name or email.
users.passwordIntro: The old password will stop working and {{name}} is signed out on every device. At the next sign-in they choose a new password.

bank.title: Question bank
bank.loadFailed: We couldn't load the questions. Check your connection and try again. Unsaved changes in the editor are kept.
bank.emptyText: Write your first question or copy questions from the shared library. Only questions marked "Ready" can appear in exams.
bank.pickOne: Pick a question from the list to edit it.
bank.explanationHelp: The candidate sees it once results are published.
bank.newOptionHelp: The last option of each list creates a new one.
bank.poolsHelp: Exam items pick questions from a set. A question can be in several sets.
bank.singleHelp: Tick the correct option. The order of the options is shuffled for each candidate.
bank.multiHelp: Tick every correct option. The answer is correct only if it picks all of them and nothing else.
bank.dualHelp: True / false questions can't use values that change: whether the statement is true could change with them.
bank.acceptedHelp: Capital letters, extra spaces and diacritics don't matter.
bank.numberHelp: Both the comma and the point work: 2,5 = 2.5.
bank.fractionHelp: Only the form written here is accepted: 3/4, not 6/8 or 0.75.
bank.answerFromValues: The correct answer comes from the formula under "Values".
bank.tryWithSample: For the values of the first sample, the expected answer is {{answer}}.
bank.valuesHelp: Write the values you define below in braces, e.g. {p}. Random values are whole numbers between min and max. Calculated ones use the other values.
bank.conditionsHelp: Separate several conditions with a semicolon, e.g. p < q; q ≠ 6.
bank.previewFailed: We couldn't compute samples. Try again.
bank.baremSum: The steps add up to {{sum}} / {{points}} points.
bank.baremNoBarem: Without a marking scheme you give one score, from 0 to the question's points, when grading.
bank.draftNote: This is a draft: it can't be drawn for any candidate until you mark it "Ready".
bank.refused: Your changes weren't saved. A ready question must stay complete. Fill in what's missing, or move the question to drafts and save again.
bank.notReady: It can't be marked "Ready" yet. See what's missing below.
bank.saveFailed: Your changes weren't saved. We couldn't reach the server; your changes stay here. Try again.
bank.publishedDone: Published as {{code}}. Other examiners can copy it into their bank.
bank.alreadyPublished: The question is already in the shared library.
bank.codeHelp: Unique in your bank. Letters, digits and hyphens. It can't be changed once the question is created.
bank.codeInvalid: Use only letters, digits, - _ and . (at most 28 characters).
bank.codeTaken: You already have a question with this code. Choose another.
bank.newHelp: It is saved as a draft. You fill in the other fields in the editor.
bank.competenceHelp: It joins your list of competences and is chosen for the open question.
bank.name: Name
bank.nameTaken: It is already in your list.
bank.deleteText: It can't be recovered. It leaves every set; the copy in the shared library stays. A question already drawn for a candidate can't be deleted.
bank.deleteDrawn: The question was already drawn for a candidate and can't be deleted.
bank.copyHelp: The copy becomes your question. Its competence and topic join your lists if you don't have them.
bank.libraryNote: The copy becomes your question: you can change it without changing the original. Only ready questions can be published to the library.
bank.libraryEmpty: The shared library is empty. Ready questions that examiners publish appear here.
bank.failed: We couldn't reach the server. Try again.

problem.invalid_range: The range of {{name}} isn't valid: min and max are whole numbers, min ≤ max.
problem.invalid_formula: A formula uses something other than whole numbers, values, + − · : and parentheses.

problem.answer_required: Write the formula of the correct answer.
problem.values_not_allowed: True / false questions can't use values that change.
problem.no_valid_draw: No combination of values meets the conditions with whole results. Widen the ranges or change the conditions.
